title: Quantum Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning via Variational Quantum Circuits
abstract: arXiv:2605.03434v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: While parameterized quantum computations have shown success in standard reinforcement learning (RL), whether these advantages adapt to hierarchical RL (HRL) remains a critical open question. This work demonstrates that variational quantum circuits (VQCs) can effectively enhance HRL agents based on the option-critic architecture. Evaluated in standard environments, a hybrid HRL agent with a quantum feature extractor outperforms classical baselines while using fewer parameters. We also identify an architectural bottleneck: using VQCs for option-value estimation severely degrades learning. Further ablations reveal how quantum circuit design affects performance. Our work establishes design principles for parameter-efficient hybrid HRL agents.

translated_title: 基于变分量子线路的量子分层强化学习
translated_abstract: 虽然参数化量子计算在标准强化学习（RL）中已展现出成功，但这些优势能否适用于分层强化学习（HRL）仍是一个关键的开放性问题。本工作证明变分量子线路（VQCs）可以有效增强基于option-critic架构的分层强化学习智能体。在标准环境中的评估表明，配备量子特征提取器的混合HRL智能体在使用更少参数的情况下优于经典基线方法。我们还发现了一个架构瓶颈：使用VQCs进行选项价值估计会严重降低学习性能。进一步的消融实验揭示了量子线路设计如何影响性能。我们的工作为参数高效的混合HRL智能体建立了设计原则。
tldr: 该论文首次将变分量子线路成功应用于基于option-critic架构的分层强化学习，以更少参数实现优于经典方法的性能，并揭示了量子线路在选项价值估计中的架构瓶颈及关键设计原则。
en_tdlr: This work demonstrates that variational quantum circuits can effectively enhance option-critic-based hierarchical RL agents with fewer parameters, while identifying an architectural bottleneck in option-value estimation and establishing quantum circuit design principles.
